name: The Hounds' Leash
vestige: Seriach, master of the burning hounds
summary: Resistance to fire, and your weapon blows burn for an extra 1d6 fire. The price: vulnerability to cold, and beasts that panic at your smell.

source.note: A vestige of the Amber Temple (Curse of Strahd chapter 13 in spirit). The vestige's name is the book's; the gift, its benefit, its price and every word here are ours, designed for this game. Found in amber_temple_vault (the hall of vestiges).

benefit.text: Hellfire runs in your blood like a hound on a long leash. Your blows leave scorch marks.

cost.flaw: Somewhere just out of sight, the hounds are always following. Dogs howl when you pass, and horses won't carry you without a fight.
cost.text: The fire in you hates the cold, and the cold has noticed.
